tips.text: Run Mother's tier 3 to 5 non-Steel Path bounties; they are the fastest Family Token source.
Bank tokens and turn them in on later days; you can earn them past the daily cap.
Tranq-capture wildlife with the Tranq Rifle from Son for the easiest non-bounty tokens.
Trade mixed tokens to Grandmother for Grandmother tokens; they pay 1.5x the standing.
Buy and build Blades and Gauntlets before MR 9; only the main blueprint needs it.
Nobody complains about this farm; it is one or two Cambion Drift sessions and a Travoride trip.
